propertyFilterType.description: Property filter type: "log_attribute" or "log_resource_attribute". Use this as the `type` field when filtering.

matchedOn.description:
How the search query matched this row: "key" if the attribute key matched, "value" if a value matched.

* `key` - key
* `value` - value

matchedValue.description: Sample matching value — only set when matchedOn is "value".
